description: LEAP-RPI-2020: Seismic interaction of a liquefiable soil with a cantilever retaining wall is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Mourad Zeghal, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (rpi.edu). The Liquefaction Experiments and Analysis Projects (LEAP) is an international collaboration to develop a databank of high-quality centrifuge experimental data and to use this data in calibration and validation of numerical tools of soil liquefaction and associated consequences. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Soil liquefaction, retaining wall, model tests, round robin tests, centrifuge, experiments. Published 2023-11-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
